headline: Should Best Buy’s (BBY) Shift to Smaller Stores and Higher-Margin Platforms Reshape Its Core Story?
summary: In recent weeks, incoming Best Buy CEO Jason Bonfig has outlined plans to expand into smaller-format stores in previously unserved communities while pushing further into higher-margin areas such as Best Buy Ads, Marketplace, and broader technology services. This shift suggests Best Buy is repositioning itself beyond big-box electronics retail toward a more diversified role spanning retail, media, and technology solutions.
